gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-wix-madefor-display: Distinctive and a bit showy, Bruno Ace draws every line like it was traced along a ruler. Wix Madefor Display, a plain sans with gently flared curve ends, sits beneath it and softens the whole page without competing.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-wix-madefor-text: Bruno Ace draws its whole outline with a ruler-straight, unmodulated line. Wix Madefor Text follows in sans-serif with open terminals, and at a modest size under a larger heading, the two sit together comfortably.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ysabeau: Bruno Ace looks cut from wire, its counters staying open to the outside and each character getting its own beat. And Ysabeau, a sans with sweeping curves that never close up, gives that stiff precision an approachable, human warmth.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ysabeau-infant: Approachable and contemporary, the body text has terminals that point outward like a pair of tongs. Ysabeau Infant takes the page's friendliest role, while Bruno Ace keeps its thin, uniform strokes and lingering one-character-per-beat rhythm up top.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ysabeau-office: Ysabeau Office is a modern sans whose curved letters all stay open-ended. Under Bruno Ace's soft, featureless hum, a longer passage would move along easily, each line feeling light and uncluttered.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ysabeau-sc: Bruno Ace has a pipe-cleaner look, with counters that stay connected to the outside and one character per beat. Ysabeau SC brings a visibly gaping c, and a longer passage in it would read in a modern, professional voice that feels crisp.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-zalando-sans: Neutral and approachable, Zalando Sans is a plain sans whose curves all end open. Beneath Bruno Ace's wire-like line, a longer passage would flow smoothly, with the body quietly taking over from the heading's showiness.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-zalando-sans-expande: Bruno Ace holds a single-weight outline feel and a ruler-drawn line, with each character getting its own beat. Zalando Sans Expanded, a plain sans with c tips that never creep toward touching, would give a longer passage a spacious, clean rhythm.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-zalando-sans-semiexp: Bruno Ace has no thin hairline anywhere, just a ruler-drawn line of constant width. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded adds open-mouthed curves on c, e, and s, and that modern openness is the pairing's strongest draw.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Modern and clean, ZCOOL XiaoWei varies its weight calmly from stem to serif, with no ink pooling where curves turn. Yet Bruno Ace does the bolder work, giving the display line stroke ends as wide as its middle and a lingering rhythm.
